title: Works great. Works on chip bags!
text:
Works great. Works on chip bags!. Excellent product. I haven't had it long to determine if it will last a long time but I love it. I have 2 other foodsaver vacuum sealers, but so far this is my favorite. One of the thingsI love most about it, is the onboard vacuum hose which can be used for jars. You do have to purchase an additional part to vacuum seal mason jars (this is NOT the same as canning) I have not tried it on the included bags, but I'm looking forward to trying that part.
The other thing I love about it is that it will vacuum seal other bags. I did a bag of potato chips. I just pressed the button to stop it from vacuuming before it crushed the chips. It vacuumed and sealed a regular bag of chips!!!

The regular vacuum sealing works great!

product_metadata.title: FoodSaver FM3920 2 in 1 Vacuum Sealer System with Quick Marinate Mode and Starter Kit | Safety Certified | Silver
features: SAVE MONEY AND SEAL FRESHNESS IN: Meat preserved with the FoodSaver System in the freezer can last up to 3 years and still taste fresh, flavorful, and freezer burn free. Prep ahead meals, leftovers, and produce stored in the fridge will stay fresh up to weeks later instead of spoiling in days

INTEGRATED ROLL STORAGE & CUTTER: Convenient roll storage with built in cutter lets you easily create custom-sized bags to suit your needs without using scissors. Then LED light indicators guide you through the vacuum sealing process. Just press the vacuum and seal button to remove the air that causes freezer burn and spoilage that's why FoodSaver is the #1 vacuum sealing system
VERY CONSISTENT SEALING: Guaranteed to reach an optimal vacuum level and airtight seal. The FM3920 is durable, high quality, and backed by a 5 year limited warranty

SEAL WET AND DRY ITEMS: Equipped with 2 modes, dry and moist, to ensure an airtight seal is achieved regardless of the type of food you are sealing. The patented removable drip tray will catch any overflow liquid and is dishwasher safe, making this kitchen appliance easy to clean and maintain

NRTL TESTED & CERTIFIED PRODUCT: All FoodSaver appliances are ETL or UL certified by Nationally Recognized Test Laboratories (NRTLs) for compliance with applicable product safety test standards. Safety is our #1 priority

COMPATIBILITY: Works with FoodSaver 8" and 11" Vacuum Seal Rolls, All Pre Made Bag Sizes, FreshSaver Zipper Bags, Fresh Containers, and Quick Marinator. Optional accessories include FoodSaver regular and wide mouth mason jar sealers and FoodSaver bottle stoppers for wine and oil bottles
description: Combining both a handheld and standard vacuum sealer, the FoodSaver FM3920 2-in-1 Vacuum Sealer System is compact vacuum sealing versatility at its best. Powerful technology eliminates air from specially designed bags to prevent freezer burn. When sealing FoodSaver zipper bags and Fresh containers, the convenient handheld retractable sealer eliminates the need for additional attachments. Wattage - 130w

The FoodSaver FM3920-ECR 2-in-1 Manual Operation Vacuum Sealing System for Food Preservation and Sous Vide includes a handheld sealer that seals FoodSaver zipper bags, canisters, and containers, and marinates food in minutes.
